## Context
The generated configuration narrative says resolved configuration is exposed through an MCP configuration-transparency surface. No such MCP tool exists. The assertion originated in the accepted generator design on `consensual-ignored-ivorygull`.

## Plan
- Correct the curated narrative in `scripts/gen_config_reference.py`.
- Retain accurate `rebar config` CLI exposure guidance.
- Regenerate `docs/config-reference.md`.
- Rename the focused topic label to CLI exposure while retaining positive coverage of the implemented CLI guidance.
- Add an explicit negative generator regression test that fails if the rendered narrative claims an MCP configuration-transparency or MCP configuration surface.
- Do not add an MCP tool or change configuration behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Generated configuration guidance contains no MCP configuration-surface claim.
- [ ] Implemented CLI configuration inspection remains documented accurately.
- [ ] Regeneration leaves `docs/config-reference.md` current.
- [ ] Focused generator tests include an explicit negative guard and fail on restoration of the unsupported claim.
- [ ] Configuration runtime and MCP tool inventory are unchanged.
